title: Codex Paired with a Profile is INSANE
author: YuukiCrypto
selftext:
Just as the title says, using Codex paired with a profiler is changing my life...

  
I've been a professional software engineer for over 10 years now and one of the biggest challenges was always digging into the telemetry. Data always helps find bugs when you have to troubleshoot.

  
I would say half of my programming career has been spent just digging through profilers and DOM trees...

  
One of the main reasons I even use AI as a HOBBY is because I love to figure out what it can do that I always hated to do. Using your AI agent to help you with profiling is truly game changing..

  
Optimization is core to any good software. Gaming amplifies that because each frame tick requires lots of things to happen within just a few millions of a second: lighting, shadows, gravity, animations, etc

  
So I had to share with you all once I found out how to properly prompt my agent to profile for me. It is incredible. I am very experienced with debugging bad software. So commanding an agent to do that work for me is magical...

  
Not only do I learn cool information about my own system, but I now have the ability to command an agent to dig through any broken system, whether its mine or not. Profiling and logging heap/memory/input/output for my agent to analyze has changed my life.

  
Like seriously, I might cry writing this post... I love coding but fixing the bugs I made SUCKS. Now, there isn't a single bug that will be able to evade me... 

I dont know.. This seems one of the few real AI first communities so wanted to share, rant, and vent all at once haha. Debugging is so much more fun when you actually understand on a microscopic level why your systems are failing...

What are your thoughts on profiling and debugging with AI?
